macros.name: edknamestyle
macros.doc: Every ⟨prefix⟩ and ⟨taxon name⟩ use the font style defined by \edknamestyle, or by default \bfseries\itshape.

envs.name: Key
envs.doc: An identification key should be made within a Key environment, i.e. between \begin{Key} [⟨prefix⟩] and \end{Key}.
